title: Fourier expansion of the squared norm of a noised function
statement:
Let $n\in\bbn$, let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function, and let $\rho\in\bbr$. Write $T_\rho$ for the noise operator with parameter $\rho$, $\langle\,\cdot\,,\,\cdot\,\rangle$ for the $L^2$ inner product under the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$, and $\hat f(S)$ for the Fourier--Walsh coefficient of $f$ at frequency $S\subseteq[n]$. Then
\[
  \langle T_\rho f,\, T_\rho f\rangle
  \;=\; \sum_{S\subseteq[n]} \bigl(\rho^{|S|}\bigr)^2\,\hat f(S)^2 .
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
The squared $L^2$ norm of $T_\rho f$ expands over the Fourier spectrum:
\[
  \langle T_\rho f, T_\rho f \rangle
  = \sum_{S \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n} \rho^{2\abs{S}}\,\widehat{f}(S)^2.
\]
